Mixed purées

Fish with sweet potato and celeriac

Halas édesburgonya zellerrel

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Check for bones again on the plate. This contains fish and celery.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 120 g skinless boneless cod or hake (fresh or plain frozen, not smoked; not carp)
  • 200 g sweet potato (peeled weight)
  • 80 g celeriac (peeled weight; celery allergen)
  • a pinch dried thyme (or a few fresh leaves, stem removed)

Allergens

fishcelery

Method

  1. Peel the sweet potato and celeriac and cook them in unsalted water until soft.
  2. Add the fish and thyme and simmer until the fish is opaque and flakes, about 5 minutes.
  3. Take the pan off the heat and check the fish with clean fingers, removing every bone.
  4. Blend until smooth.
  5. Do not add salt, and do not use carp.

Adjusted

Celeriac is a celery allergen. Carp is a poor choice because of the bones.

Use boneless salmon, trout, cod, or hake, cooked through, and check for bones. Blend it with sweet potato, celeriac, and thyme, and do not use carp.
